literal_source_objects.J: law(X,X+sqrt(eta)G), X~mu and independent G~N(0,I); same as normalized joint exp(-V(x)-norm(x-y)^2/(2eta))dxdy.
literal_source_objects.P_U: P is true conditional expectation under same J; U pullback f(x,2x-y); U_PP=PUP on macro classes. This operator notation does not license pointwise regularity of an arbitrary AE representative.
literal_source_objects.R_y: Specified normalized conditional posterior: exp(-V(x)-norm(x-y)^2/(2eta))dx/Z_R(y). This is the literal density version, not any unspecified AE conditional representative.
literal_source_objects.S_y: Conditional law of Y_minus given Y_plus=y, specified as pushforward of same R_y by x->2x-y; printed density p_y(u) proportional to exp(-W_y(u)).
literal_source_objects.Tf: Literal T_f(y)=integral f(2x-y)R_y(dx)=integral f(u)S_y(du). It represents U_PP f in L2(nu); equality to an arbitrary L2 representative is only AE nu.
literal_source_objects.W_y: Expository name for V((y+u)/2)+norm(y-u)^2/(8eta), exactly A3.Ex1. Source proportional-density display leaves normalization implicit.
literal_source_objects.Y_pair: Y_plus=X+sqrt(eta)G, Y_minus=X-sqrt(eta)G=2X-Y_plus; pair exchangeable, marginals both nu.
literal_source_objects.Z_S: Integral exp(-W_y(u))du. After actual affine change x=(y+u)/2, du=2^d dx and Z_S(y)=2^d Z_R(y).
literal_source_objects.mu: mu(dx)=exp(-V(x))dx/Z_V, genuine probability; Z_V integral exp(-V) finite positive derived from source curvature/continuity.
literal_source_objects.nu: J.snd=pi_eta^Y=mu*N(0,eta I), actual outer law. It is not a conditional fiber S_y.
literal_source_objects.parameter_y_score: s_y(u)=-gradientV((y+u)/2)/2-(y-u)/(4eta)=-gradient_y W_y(u), unnormalized log-weight score; normalized density log-score is s_y-E_Sy(s_y).
literal_source_objects.u_gradient: gradient_u W_y(u)=gradientV((y+u)/2)/2+(u-y)/(4eta). It is distinct from -s_y(u).
literal_source_objects.variance: Var_Sy(f)=integral (f-integral f dSy)^2 dSy with genuine probability/integrability; no f-centering input.

normalization_and_pointwise_contract.affine_scale: Norm(x-y)^2/(2eta) under u=2x-y becomes norm(u-y)^2/(8eta). Pushforward density has Jacobian factor2^-d; its normalization cancels through Z_S=2^d Z_R. Gibbs Z_V cancels in the normalized posterior of mu.
normalization_and_pointwise_contract.conditional_version_boundary: Disintegration alone identifies conditional kernels only nu-almost everywhere. The intended source-normalized-density version supplies an everywhere specified formula; no arbitrary AE equality can transport pointwise C1/derivatives.
normalization_and_pointwise_contract.literal_density: Source shows proportional p_y; exact normalized adapter must internally derive finite/positive Z_R/Z_S for every y and exp(-W)/Z_S density, then equality of the same specified posterior-reflection law to that density at every y.
normalization_and_pointwise_contract.no_unneeded_public_certificates: Normalizer positivity/L1, Jacobian/density law, domination, first moments, derivative continuity, conditional-kernel identity and closed-gradient membership are proof obligations, not new source hypotheses.
normalization_and_pointwise_contract.same_mean: Pointwise law equality implies equality of the literal mean functions on all y, permitting actual function-level regularity transfer once produced. AE-only equality permits means/classes transport but not pointwise derivative substitution.
